name: 2014-2015 frozen-book stress reproduction
sample: Scored dates are commodity 2014-01-01 through 2015-12-31 from research shards only. 2012-2013 data is used only for prior-year pool construction and rolling warmup. 2016 and later are not scored; validation_2022, holdout_locked, and all 2026 data are not read.

execution.commission: historical fees, by-money rate x1.01 and by-volume rate +0.01 CNY/lot
execution.slippage: one prior-year estimated tick per side

purpose: Reproduce the previously inspected stress-window result with unchanged frozen rules. This run is not an independent test and must not be used for tuning or selection.
